operation.name: FMADDCPf_m
operation.code: let rc := if (context.evex_b == 0b1) and (mod == 0b11) then context.evex_LLRC else MXCSR.RC;
// Computes op1 + op2 * conj(op3) for conjugate, op1 + op2 * op3 for non-conjugate.
// op2_* (VVVV register) is kept as the first arg in ALL four FMAs to match Intel
// hardware NaN priority: NaN from op2 takes precedence over NaN from op3.
// The sign for conjugation is expressed via is_negate on the second arg (op3_imag),
// so that NaN sign of op3_imag is also preserved (negating y doesn't flip its NaN sign
// because FP::FMA's NaN priority check uses the pre-negate value uyy).
let (tmp_real, exceptions1) := FP::FMA(op2_real, op3_real, op1_real, denormals_are_zeros, rounding_mode, flush_subnormals);
let (tmp_imag, exceptions2) := FP::FMA(op2_imag, op3_real, op1_imag, denormals_are_zeros, rounding_mode, flush_subnormals);
// FMA3/FMA4 use intermediate values (tmp_real, tmp_imag) as the addend.
// These intermediates must not have DAZ applied (they are not architectural inputs).
// Pass denormals_are_zeros=False so the subnormal intermediate is preserved.
let (r_real, exceptions3) := FP::FMA(op2_imag, op3_imag, tmp_real, False, rounding_mode, flush_subnormals, False, not True);
let (r_imag, exceptions4) := FP::FMA(op2_real, op3_imag, tmp_imag, False, rounding_mode, flush_subnormals, False, True);
let exceptions := exceptions1 or exceptions2 or exceptions3 or exceptions4;

footnote.para: If EVEX.b == 0b1, a single element is read from memory and broadcast across the vector.
Memory faults while reading inactive elements are suppressed.
If EVEX.z == 0b0, the previous value of the result is read into `old` and the masking variant of the operation is used; if EVEX.z == 0b1, the zeroing variant of the operation is used.
